caseName: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Co. v. Goodrich
caseNameFull: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Company, in Error v. L. E. Goodrich
summary: In error to thé Court of Civil Appeals for the Fifth Supreme Judicial District of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. Jos. M. Bryson, Mr. Alex. S. Coke, and Mr. Aldis B. Browne for the plaintiff in error., Mr. J. A. L. Wolfe for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction, upon the authority of York v. Texas, 137 U. S. 15; Kauffman v. Wootters, 138 U. S. 285.
